title: Pick and place · Level 3: From the conveyor
brief: Catch the four balls from the moving conveyor and place them on the four coloured spots. The robot stands at (600, 600) facing 180 deg; its base turns, its arm stays in one plane. The balls (40 mm, 30 g) ride a conveyor in toward the robot along world bearing 0: a belt 60 mm wide and 60 mm high from 234.5 to 1334.5 mm out, its speed drawn per run from 15 to 25 mm/s and not given; the balls start 374.5, 654.5, 934.5 and 1214.5 mm out. The arm reaches a belt ball only at the belt's inner end, so each is caught there: it rides into the open claw and rests against the palm, the belt running under it. A ball not caught rides off the inner end to the floor (a drop); it may then roll against the robot's base and be thrown by a later turn. The spots are 40 x 40 mm, their tops coloured: s1 blue (20 mm high), s2 green (40), s3 purple (60), s4 cyan (80); each run moves them a little. The spots are seen, not given: a program finds them with the camera. No challenge run has camera frames until RC-3c or BCAM, so until then no program can find the spots here; practise on pick-and-place-bench-3, which gives them in spots.json. Per ball: 10 within 10 mm of a spot's centre, 5 within 25; -5 for a drop (a ball touching the floor), -5 for each collision of the arm with the conveyor; + 20 x min(1, par / t) when all four are within 25 mm before the limit (par 35.0 s, limit 105 s). Run score = 100 x points / 60 (floor 0). Pass: a mean of 60 and at least 8 of 10 runs finishing.

score.run: max(0, round(100 * (10 * placeHits10 + 5 * (placeHits25 - placeHits10) - 5 * placeDrops - 5 * placeTray + if(placeFinished, 20 * min(1, par / time), 0)) / 60, 1))
